$comment: Source of truth for everything sold through Stripe. Prices and capacities are Shahin's approved provisional launch-year values for the Stripe sandbox (2026-11-14); confirm them before the live run. Money values are CAD dollars as strings ('450.00'), before tax. Every product is sold separately per edition: one Stripe product, price and payment link per city, with the capacity per city. A value that differs by city is written as {"toronto": ..., "montreal": ...}. Set "per_edition": false on a product to sell one link for both cities. Capacity counts completed checkouts (orders), not people. "show_price": false hides the price on the website (Stripe checkout still shows it). "checkout_note" is shown on the Stripe checkout page next to the pay button. Every 'TODO' blocks a real sync, except tax_code. Public Payment Link URLs are written to site/data/summit-tickets.json by scripts/stripe/sync-catalogue.mjs; nothing secret lives in either file.
tax_code: TODO(Shahin): Stripe product tax code once the accountant confirms; until then the default product tax code in the Stripe Tax settings applies
tax_note: Prices in Canadian dollars. GST/HST and QST are added at checkout where they apply.
